Package com.sciometrics.android.slapshot.api.capture

Interface ISlapshotCaptureEngine

All Known Implementing Classes:
SlapshotCaptureEngine
public interface ISlapshotCaptureEngine
The slapshot engine interface. Contains the main non-UI entry points for the slapshot engine. Created by SlapshotCaptureSDK.getEngine()

  • Method Details

    • installLicense

      void installLicense(InputStream license) throws com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException
      Installs the offline produced license for the Slapshot Capture SDK. The license is produced from a license request made from
      invalid @link 
      {@link ISlapshotCaptureEngine#createOfflineLicenseRequest(String).
      } If not already installed, this method must be called AFTER configuration (configure(ICaptureEngineConfig)) and before use of the SDK capture and export calls. The installation is persistent between app sessions. No network connection is required for licensing the SDK in this manner
      Parameters:
      license - a stream of the license activation created offline
      Throws:
      com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException - error

    • activateLicenseKey

      void activateLicenseKey(String licenseKey) throws com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException
      Activates the given license key. This requires the device to be connected to the internet for the duration of the call. If successful, then a license has been installed for the device. Calls to installLicense(InputStream) are not required when using this method. This should be called AFTER checking to see if isLicensed() returns false. After a successful license key has been activated, then this call will not be necessary in subsequent app sessions because isLicensed() will return true. This method requires a network connection and needs to be called from a BACKGROUND THREAD because it makes a web service call. This should be called AFTER configuration (configure(ICaptureEngineConfig)) AND initialization ISlapshotCaptureEngineUI.init(FragmentActivity, InitializationCallback) and BEFORE use of the SDK capture and export calls.
      Parameters:
      licenseKey - the license key to activate
      Throws:
      com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException - error

    • isLicensed

      boolean isLicensed() throws com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException
      whether the SDK currently has a valid, installed license. The license could either be from a previous call to installLicense(InputStream) or activateLicenseKey(String) (). If this method returns true, then no calls to either installLicense(InputStream) or activateLicenseKey(String) are required for use of the SDK (this persists between app sessions)
      Returns:
      true if licensed, false otherwise
      Throws:
      com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException

    • createOfflineLicenseRequest

      String createOfflineLicenseRequest(String licenseKey) throws com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException
      returns a request for an offline license based on the given licenseKey. This String can be saved as a file which is a license request that can be used to generate a license file via .... The externally generated ls_activation.lic file would then be used with installLicense(InputStream). This method is NOT used when licensing via activateLicenseKey(String)
      Returns:
      a request for an offline license. This String should be saved as a file and used in the vendor portal to create an offline license
      Throws:
      com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException

    • exportCaptureIdentity

      IBiometricPayload exportCaptureIdentity(IExportCaptureRequest exportCaptureRequest, com.sciometrics.core.util.ICancelToken cancelToken) throws com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException
      exports a captured identity. The turns the biometric captures into their extracted and processed individual biometrics. E.g. a capture sequence of a L4FS and a R4FS will be exported as the processed, AFIS ready slaps and the individually extracted fingers
      Parameters:
      exportCaptureRequest - the export capture request
      cancelToken - cancel token
      Returns:
      the biometric payload containing the data for the individual processed biometrics for the identity
      Throws:
      com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException - an error during the export

    • addModelBasedCalibration

      boolean addModelBasedCalibration(byte[] calibrationBytes) throws com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException
      adds a model based calibration to the set of supported model based calibrations. should be the byte representation of a file that was exporting using ISlapshotCaptureEngineUI.exportCalibration(). When a calibration is run where model-based calibration is supported/requested, if the make and model of the running device matches a calibration that has been loaded using this method, then model-based calibration will be used. If no matching calibration is found, then default calibration will proceed. Model-based calibration reduces the number of calibration captures that are required to calibrate the device.
      Parameters:
      calibrationBytes - the bytes from a file exporting using ISlapshotCaptureEngineUI.exportCalibration()
      Returns:
      true if the calibration represented by matches the make and model of the running device
      Throws:
      com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException - an error occurred

    • addModelBasedCalibration

      boolean addModelBasedCalibration(byte[] calibrationBytes, Function<DeviceInfo,Boolean> matchingFunction) throws com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException
      adds a model based calibration to the set of supported model based calibrations. should be the byte representation of a file that was exporting using ISlapshotCaptureEngineUI.exportCalibration(). When a calibration is run where model-based calibration is supported/requested, if the make and model of the running device matches a calibration that has been loaded using this method, then model-based calibration will be used. If no matching calibration is found, then default calibration will proceed. Model-based calibration reduces the number of calibration captures that are required to calibrate the device.
      Parameters:
      calibrationBytes - the bytes from a file exporting using ISlapshotCaptureEngineUI.exportCalibration()
      matchingFunction - a user-supplied function that will evaluate whether the running device matches the model of the calibration. The default matching function strictly matches the lower-case, invariant make and model strings of the calibration and the running device to see if the model-based calibration will be used. This allows that comparison to be overridden by the caller, in case the strict string matching needs to be altered (e.g. if the string representatio of the model changes based on the country the device is distributed in)
      Returns:
      true if the calibration represented by matches the make and model of the running device
      Throws:
      com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException - an error occurred
